scientific_integrity: Same-model-reviewed proof of a new embedded plane-curve singularity classification; relies on standard tame plane-branch and conductor lemmas, supplemented by reproducible exact checks. No external certification.
scientific_limitations: For odd prime characteristic, d>p+2 and p not dividing d-1 only; does not determine formal analytic normal form or full resolution graph; literature priority beyond checked sources not exhaustive.
title: Two-branch infinity and conductor of a twisted Artin--Schreier plane model
